name: Streamer University
overview:
Streamer University is a groundbreaking, high-energy live-streamed reality competition and creator bootcamp created and fully funded by Twitch and YouTube superstar Kai Cenat.

The innovative series brings together a massive roster of over 100 aspiring and established content creators, housing them in a real university campus dormitory. Over the course of an intense multi-day event, these "students" attend lectures led by industry giants, compete in challenges, and stream their experience 24/7 to a global audience. Featuring legendary guest professors like Ludwig, Valkyrae, and T-Pain, the show blends real-world content creation education with chaotic, viral reality TV entertainment.
